I personally like charts. And stats. And patterns. For the most part. Things that stand out that makes me go giggity giggity goo inside, you feel me? Lol

If I had to start from zero on X, I would prioritize that. I honestly think that is what primarily gave me my start on the socials. 

I don’t always chart or look at things the conventional way (or even the “right” way) and sometimes there is alpha in that. Believe it or not.

People love to see visuals on top of just texts and numbers. Keep a balanced approach on your X. Make it interesting. Make it fun. Make it so I want to go to your page and see what you have to say. 

Differentiate yourself. Unique. Original. 

It’s easier said than done, I know. There will be down days. Slump days. Slow days. “I wanna give up” days. It’s part of the process.

When I permanently left/deleted Stocktwits around 2018, l left behind 50k or so followers. I told myself I can’t do this socials anymore. Took a 2 year hiatus from it. Then in 2021 went to Twitter (yes I know it said created in 2018 but was a dormant 0 follower account) and started from zero.

So yes, I infact actually did start zero.

You just gotta start. Sooner better than later. Even if you are talking to a void. Hell, just do it. If your shit is good enough, eventually THEY will come.

Good luck my man.

Here to support small accounts.

Not only have they failed to bring manufacturing back to the U.S., but the U.S. is now more dependent than ever on foreign producers. Not only are we importing more than ever, but we are now paying Trump's tariffs on those imports. 

Trump says trade deficits represent a loss. Judged by his own standard, Trump is the biggest loser in the history of the presidency. Also, if the economy is booming as Republicans claim, why have our trade deficits gone way up? Why are the trade deficits under Trump so much larger than they were under Biden, when, according to Trump, we had the worst economy in U.S. history?  

Here are the facts. When you compare Trump's first two years to Biden's last two, GDP growth and job creation are slower, inflation is higher, and budget and trade deficits are bigger. If Trump is right that under Biden we had the worst economy in history, and the Trump economy is objectively worse on all counts, then the Trump economy is now the worst economy in history.
